r3fig_planner_forest.caption: Closed-loop planner outcomes in five traffic conditions (rows). The planner is identical in all arms; only the risk input differs: A = static observation (the observed positions as static obstacles), B = constant-velocity (CV) extrapolation, C = PRISM (checkpoint 20260926_141629_r3_k3_s1). (a)–(c) Ratio of per-hour event rates, B/C (squares) and A/C (circles), on a log axis; a ratio above 1 means fewer events in arm C. Events are union events over all intruders at 20 Hz whose minimum separation falls below 152.4 m (a) or 76.2 m (b); (c) counts the 152.4 m events whose minimum is below 45 m. Events whose lead time from current-track detection to threshold entry is shorter than t_need = 8.23 s, or unknown, are excluded as unavoidable (current-track screen). Bars: 95 % confidence intervals from a paired episode bootstrap (B = 10,000 resamples of the paired episodes, seed 20260926). (d) Time during which the minimum separation to any intruder is below 45 m (20 Hz, no avoidability screen), seconds per exposure hour, per arm. Conditions: OOD sparse (sparse): preset test_ood, 4 agents, density 8 per km², 300 paired episodes, 7.46 h of exposure per arm; OOD nominal load (ood40): preset test_ood, 24 agents, density 40 per km², 600 paired episodes, 14.92 h of exposure per arm; OOD saturated (ood100): preset test_ood, 36 agents, density 100 per km², 300 paired episodes, 7.46 h of exposure per arm; ID nominal (id40): preset test_id, 20 agents, density 40 per km², 300 paired episodes, 7.46 h of exposure per arm; ID matched load (id24): preset test_id, 24 agents, density 40 per km², 300 paired episodes, 7.46 h of exposure per arm. Exact two-sided sign tests on the per-episode time below 45 m (episodes with less time for the first arm / for the second arm / ties): sparse: B vs C 7/14/279, p = 0.189; A vs C 7/20/273, p = 0.019; A vs B 8/21/271, p = 0.024; ood40: B vs C 69/98/433, p = 0.030; A vs C 56/127/417, p < 0.001; A vs B 90/125/385, p = 0.020; ood100: B vs C 53/61/186, p = 0.512; A vs C 34/79/187, p < 0.001; A vs B 52/79/169, p = 0.023; id40: B vs C 21/58/221, p < 0.001; A vs C 15/59/226, p < 0.001; A vs B 40/55/205, p = 0.151; id24: B vs C 34/59/207, p = 0.012; A vs C 15/69/216, p < 0.001; A vs B 39/67/194, p = 0.008.

r3fig_shared_geometry.caption: Hard-constraint geometry control at nominal OOD load (preset test_ood, 24 agents, density 40 per km²; paired episode indices 0-299, 300 episodes, 7.46 h per arm). A = static observation, B = CV, C = PRISM. Arm geometry (filled markers; run knob hard_geom = arm): each arm checks hard feasibility against its own risk disks, as in the planner-outcome figure. Shared geometry (open markers; hard_geom = shared): every arm checks hard feasibility against the same disks at the observed intruder positions at t0, while the soft risk term stays arm-specific (definition: R3_RESULTS.md §4). (a) NMAC-radius events (< 152.4 m) and (b) severe events (< 45 m) per exposure hour, current-track screen. (c, d) Paired ratios of per-hour rates (first / second run; above 1 = fewer events in the second) with 95 % confidence intervals from a paired episode bootstrap (B = 10,000, seed 20260926): between arms within each geometry, and arm geometry / shared geometry within each arm. For arm A the two geometries gave the same per-episode counts in 300 of 300 episodes (152.4 m) and 300 of 300 (45 m).

r3fig_sensitivity.caption: One-factor sensitivity of the closed-loop comparison B/C (CV / PRISM) at nominal OOD load (preset test_ood, 24 agents, density 40 per km²; paired episode indices 0-299, 300 episodes, 7.46 h per arm and setting). Each row changes the listed setting(s) in both arms relative to the baseline (σ floor 10 m, plateau ×1, safety weight w_safety 12, pool normalisation, S_REF None, π_min 0.05, isotropic reduction: rms, gain mode pi); rows in order: σ floor 1 m; σ floor 20 m; plateau ×0.5; plateau ×2; safety weight w_safety 6; safety weight w_safety 24; absolute normalisation, S_REF 23.61; π_min 0.2 (PRISM arm only); isotropic reduction: max (PRISM arm only); isotropic reduction: min (PRISM arm only). A row marked 'PRISM arm only' was run for PRISM alone and is paired with the baseline CV arm. (a) NMAC-radius events (< 152.4 m), (b) severe events (< 45 m), current-track screen. Points: ratio of per-hour event rates (above 1 = fewer events with PRISM); bars: 95 % confidence intervals from a paired episode bootstrap (B = 10,000, seed 20260926). Light grey vertical line: baseline estimate; dark line: ratio 1. The baseline pair is identical in every sensitivity file: yes.

(a)–(c) Mean over groups of the per-group HPD coverage at nominal 0.5 / 0.7 / 0.9 (horizontal lines) versus horizon; whiskers: 95 % percentile intervals of a group bootstrap (B = 2000, seed 20260926). r3fig_per_class.caption: Type-aware prediction. From 10 s of observed track alone the network recovers the object class ((a): ID accuracy 0.908; correct share per true class Multirotor 97.3 %, Fixed-wing UAS 91.9 %, eVTOL 77.5 %), its forecast error is class-specific and below both online baselines (CV, IMM) in every class (b), and its 90 % HPD coverage stays near nominal in every trained class (c); on the OOD set (d) the classes absent from training are absorbed into the nearest trained class (Bird → Multirotor (63 %), General aviation → eVTOL (95 %), Debris → Multirotor (97 %), Unknown → eVTOL (41 %)) and the largest OOD errors fall on Unknown 100.0 m, Bird 85.1 m, while Debris (34.1 m) is the easiest class of all. Planner checkpoint 20260926_141629_r3_k3_s1 (seed 1); current-track test sets, ID n = 170,076 samples from 900 episodes, OOD n = 399,403 from 1,200 episodes. (a) Row-normalised confusion of the auxiliary type head (argmax over all seven classes; rows = true class, columns = predicted class; only trained classes are ever predicted, so the OOD accuracy over seven classes is 0.352). (b, d) minADE per true class for PRISM (C), CV extrapolation of the observed track (B), an IMM filter (CV / CT / CA) and CV extrapolation of the true state (an information upper bound not available to any online method); bars: 95 % percentile intervals of an episode-cluster bootstrap (B = 2,000 resamples of episodes, seed 20260926); the baseline point values equal the by_type field of the baseline reports. (c) Coverage of the nominal 90 % HPD region at 5, 10, 15 s per class (Monte-Carlo HPD membership of the evaluation), line: nominal; same bootstrap. In (d) the shaded classes were absent from training and the arrow gives the trained class they are most often assigned to. ID per class: Multirotor (n = 70,612): PRISM 35.5 m [35.0, 35.9], CV 112.2 m, IMM 74.0 m, CV on the true state 25.8 m; 90 % coverage at 5/10/15 s = 0.895/0.894/0.906; Fixed-wing UAS (n = 59,900): PRISM 57.3 m [56.6, 58.0], CV 136.4 m, IMM 112.3 m, CV on the true state 59.6 m; 90 % coverage at 5/10/15 s = 0.881/0.880/0.900; eVTOL (n = 39,564): PRISM 48.2 m [47.3, 49.1], CV 119.9 m, IMM 95.2 m, CV on the true state 35.6 m; 90 % coverage at 5/10/15 s = 0.886/0.887/0.891. OOD per class: Multirotor (n = 64,386): PRISM 46.7 m [46.2, 47.1], CV 115.6 m, IMM 83.6 m, CV on the true state 35.0 m, 90 % coverage at 15 s 0.818; Fixed-wing UAS (n = 61,986): PRISM 64.8 m [64.2, 65.5], CV 139.6 m, IMM 119.9 m, CV on the true state 65.4 m, 90 % coverage at 15 s 0.844; eVTOL (n = 36,307): PRISM 51.5 m [50.6, 52.4], CV 120.2 m, IMM 98.9 m, CV on the true state 33.5 m, 90 % coverage at 15 s 0.870; Bird (n = 83,714, unseen): PRISM 85.1 m [84.5, 85.7], CV 148.5 m, IMM 123.0 m, CV on the true state 84.9 m, 90 % coverage at 15 s 0.579; General aviation (n = 72,900, unseen): PRISM 58.6 m [57.9, 59.4], CV 122.8 m, IMM 102.3 m, CV on the true state 38.4 m, 90 % coverage at 15 s 0.789; Debris (n = 42,608, unseen): PRISM 34.1 m [33.6, 34.6], CV 105.2 m, IMM 64.7 m, CV on the true state 2.1 m, 90 % coverage at 15 s 0.962; Unknown (n = 37,502, unseen): PRISM 100.0 m [98.5, 101.5], CV 162.8 m, IMM 140.4 m, CV on the true state 96.4 m, 90 % coverage at 15 s 0.525.
